findings.summary: The comment says a fresh GenerationConfig keeps all of the model's generation defaults out. With the pinned transformers, every field left unset is still filled from the model's generation_config.
findings.evidence: transformers 5.22.1 GenerationMixin._prepare_generation_config (.venv/.../transformers/generation/utils.py:2100) runs generation_config.update(**self.generation_config.to_dict(), defaults_only=True, ...). Every field that is None in the passed config is taken from the model's generation_config.json. Only the fields set explicitly here are protected (max_new_tokens, eos, pad, repetition_penalty, do_sample, and temperature/top_p/top_k when sampling). Examples of fields that can still come from the model: min_p, typical_p, no_repeat_ngram_size, and temperature/top_p/top_k in greedy mode. Qwen2 base sets none of these today, so no output changes now. The comment's guarantee, which backs prereg section 4 ('Default sampling parameters from the model's generation config are not used'), does not hold in general.

sightings.summary: The comment says a fresh GenerationConfig keeps all of the model's generation defaults out. With the pinned transformers, every field left unset is still filled from the model's generation_config.
sightings.evidence: transformers 5.22.1 GenerationMixin._prepare_generation_config (.venv/.../transformers/generation/utils.py:2100) runs generation_config.update(**self.generation_config.to_dict(), defaults_only=True, ...). Every field that is None in the passed config is taken from the model's generation_config.json. Only the fields set explicitly here are protected (max_new_tokens, eos, pad, repetition_penalty, do_sample, and temperature/top_p/top_k when sampling). Examples of fields that can still come from the model: min_p, typical_p, no_repeat_ngram_size, and temperature/top_p/top_k in greedy mode. Qwen2 base sets none of these today, so no output changes now. The comment's guarantee, which backs prereg section 4 ('Default sampling parameters from the model's generation config are not used'), does not hold in general.
